name: 天涯&碧血江湖
group_note: 天涯之碧血江湖 (Tianya "Bixue Jianghu" edition, TIANYA.ZB), Tianya MUD Wizard Group, live since 2002. Boots and runs completely clean under WASM -- no compile errors, no runtime errors, no fixes needed anywhere in the codebase. Only action taken: seeded fluffos (admin) in adm/etc/wizlist (SECURITY_D correctly points at /adm/daemons/securityd, confirmed via globals.h; a decoy copy exists at u/zjb/securityd.lpc but is not wired up). Note securityd.lpc's get_status() hardcodes 4 named euids (daniel/zjb/kjh/jiji) to always return the top (boss) tier regardless of wizlist contents -- this is intentional founder-account logic, not a bug, and doesn't interact with the fluffos account. Registration flow verified end-to-end in one continuous WASM client session: English id -> y/n create-confirm -> Chinese name -> admin password + confirm -> regular password (must differ) + confirm -> gift-stat selection (0 for random, y to accept) -> email (requires id@address format) -> gender -> enters world with a full character sheet, zero unexpected errors. Admin permission directly confirmed via the post-login banner '您目前权限：(admin)'. Testing note: this lib enforces a genuine 150-second LOGIN_TIMEOUT (call_out from connect, not per-prompt) that disconnects slow registrations with '您花在连线进入手续的时间太久了' -- this is real, intentional mudlib behavior (not a WASM/test artifact), confirmed by reading clone/user/login.lpc's time_out()/LOGIN_TIMEOUT (150s, include/login.h). Early test runs with a generous --idle (6-15s) to dodge compile-warning-flood timing races instead tripped this timeout, since get_email()/get_gender() trigger heavy one-time compilation of /inherit/char/char and its features; switching to a fast --idle 2 completed registration well inside the window and is the correct approach for this lib specifically. LPC formatter run across all 9398 .lpc files (9303 written, 61 errors on messy legacy code including one confirmed pre-existing token-mismatch skip, 34 unchanged); reverted 1 file (d/city/sj.lpc) with confirmed pre-existing (author-side, predates this pass) missing-quote corruption re-spaced further by the formatter. No :: parent-call split hits. No case-label-with-trailing-comment candidates found. Diff-reviewed all 4 map.lpc files -- 3 are brace-placement-only (K&R merge); cmds/std/map.lpc's diff initially looked larger due to a long sprintf() call being re-wrapped across multiple lines, but a full-file whitespace-normalized comparison confirmed byte-for-byte content equivalence (2032 chars, identical). Post-formatter re-verified with the same full registration flow -- clean, admin permission still (admin).
